Four households are billed in groups that a signed householding agreement contradicts: **HH-0586, HH-0592, HH-0928 and HH-4821**.

I searched the CRM of all 92 households. Only these four have a signed agreement of kind "householding". All four follow the same pattern. A letter signed by all three family members says the joint account, a spouse's IRA and an adult child's individual account "are billed together as one group from the next billing cycle". As of 15 April 2026, the portfolio system still bills them in two groups: the joint account and IRA in one, the child's account alone in the other. Both groups were last changed on the date the child's advisory agreement was signed, in 2021, which is before each householding letter. So the split was never updated.

|---|---|---|
| HH-0592 Haddad | AGR-0592-3 (2023-10-20) | BG-0592-1 (joint + Bilal's IRA) / BG-0592-2 (Fatima) – 2021-09-01 |

| HH-0586 Quarshie | AGR-0586-3 (2024-06-07) | BG-0586-1 (joint + Saoirse's IRA) / BG-0586-2 (Amara) – 2021-09-01 |
| HH-4821 Okafor-Lind | AGR-4821-3 (2024-11-18) | BG-4821-1 (joint + Henrik's IRA) / BG-4821-2 (Ngozi) – 2021-09-14 |

I looked for anything that might explain the split and found nothing:
- **Accounts and parties:** The custodian's account records match the agreements. Every account is open and owned by the people who signed.
- **Later records:** No CRM note or activity revokes or replaces any of the letters. The 2025-10-14 annual review in each household says "No changes requested".
- **Billing files:** All four use the standard fee schedule with no exceptions noted.

Two things I ruled out:
